## Condition type

Represents a hook or combination of hooks that can activate declarations.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Condition<H> = H | {
    and: Condition<H>[];
} | {
    or: Condition<H>[];
} | {
    not: Condition<H>;
};
```
